turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Northwind Financial, my name is Nadia. Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is the fourth time I've called about this same charge.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry. Let me pull up the history.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Every single person tells me it's fixed and it isn't.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see three prior contacts. The dispute was closed in the merchant's favour twice.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's absurd. I have the receipt showing I returned the item.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. I can reopen it with the receipt as evidence.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No. I want a supervisor. Right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me get someone on the line for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I've wasted three hours on this. Three hours.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I hear you, and I'm escalating this to my supervisor now.

action_items: Reopen dispute with customer receipt as evidence
